title: Db-Sync Enterprise: high-availability setup of Cardano’s Db-Sync to run queries and access on-chain data as a service

ms.promise:
This process entails setting up the servers to run the Cardano node, db-sync, and a Postgres database. The setup includes configuring two fully functional db-sync pipelines, including the mentioned components.
Documentation will be added to the project's repository https://github.com/Blockchain-Data-Analytics/Cardano_Enterprise
ms.criteria:
The criteria for acceptance will focus on ensuring these pipelines run smoothly, testing failover capabilities.
The documentation will contain information on how to compile and setup Cardano node and Cardano db-sync from source code. Furthermore, we also document how to setup the database system in high-availability mode.

ms.promise:
This milestone's outputs will be the monitoring of the system. We will setup monitoring of servers and the processes: node, db-sync and postgres. Moreover, the syncing of the Cardano blockchain will be monitored.
If any of the monitored metrics is crossing a predefined limit, then an alert is sent out to the project administrators.
Server monitoring:
We will monitor CPU, disk and network I/O, and memory usage on every server. Alert limits will be set to: 80% CPU usage, 90% disk usage, 80% of network capacity, 90% memory usage. These limits are per now just indications and need to be evaluated on the live systems and set to levels which minimise risks.
Running systems:
We will monitor process health and uptime of the Cardano node, db-sync and the PostgreSQL database system.
Database usage:
We will monitor typical database metrics (replica lag, execution times of queries) as well as Cardano db-sync related metrics such as block time lag which compares the latest block's time vs. the current clock when the block is inserted into the database. Such a metric indicates whether the syncing of blocks from the Cardano blockchain is healthy.

This milestone involves setting up a web app, where users will be able to signup and select the type of database access they require. After successful signup the required resources will be created automatically and the access credentials will be shared with the user.
The user will have the option to cancel the subscription at the end of the paid period and tear down the spawned instances, or extend the subscription, as in "pay-as-you-go".
ms.criteria:
Perform a successful user signup and use the access credentials to connect to the read replica and successfully perform a database query.
Tear down services and cancel subscription to demonstrate pay-as-you-go.
